units.source_text: 在大报社的推动下，名人为了技艺之道，很重视自己出马的意义，而不单是被对局费吸引。

en.t: With the backing of a major newspaper, the Master, for the sake of the way of his art, attached great importance to the meaning of taking the field himself, and was not merely attracted by the game fee.

units.source_text: 他心中燃起的依然是必胜的信念。

en.t: What still burned in his heart was the conviction that he must win.

units.source_text: 倘使名人担心自己输棋，恐怕他就不会亲自出马。

en.t: If the Master had been worried that he might lose, he probably would not have taken the field in person.

units.source_text: 因为一旦输棋，常胜的桂冠终究会丢掉，生命也会消逝。

en.t: For once he lost, the laurel of constant victory would finally be cast away, and his life too would fade.

units.source_text: 名人顺从自己异常的天命生活过来了，

en.t: The Master had lived his life in obedience to his own extraordinary fate,

units.source_text: 顺从天命，难道可以说成是违逆天命吗？

en.t: and can obeying fate really be called defying fate?
